text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Black long-sleeve Henley sweatshirt with small light buttons, black extra-wide denim jeans with stacked hems, chunky polished black leather derby shoes.. Add ONLY these accessories: Small black rectangular crossbody pouch with long narrow black strap; Black square smartwatch with black rubber band; One black leather key fob with silver carabiner clip; Black narrow rectangular sunglasses with dark lenses. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved hollow garment ensemble. Preserve its EXACT clothing, layering, silhouette, colors, shoes and material. Input image 2 is original styling reference, ONLY for the accessories listed below. Create one complete styled outfit on a pure uniform WHITE seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light, full uncropped framing. Add ONLY these 4 listed accessories, no other objects: 1. Small black rectangular crossbody pouch with long narrow black strap; 2. Black square smartwatch with black rubber band; 3. One black leather key fob with silver carabiner clip; 4. Black narrow rectangular sunglasses with dark lenses. Attach those listed accessories naturally to the garment at realistic scale where possible; otherwise display the small listed object neatly adjacent. STRICT: do NOT add any unlisted hat, cap, eyeglasses, sunglasses, handbag, belt, jewelry, props or footwear. No person, skin, body parts, head, face, hands, visible mannequin, stand, text captions or watermark. Empty neckline and sleeves.
